name: Reka Drava
subtitle: od jezu v Markovcih do državne meje s Hrvaško, spodnja stara struga

en.name: The river Drava
en.subtitle: from the dam in Markovci to the state border with Croatia; lower old channel
en.description: This district is an old channel of the river Drava and it is flowing approximately 15m3/s. After three kilometres the river Dravinja flows into it and its waterflow is always changing - in the times of drought it is barely running but otherwise it fills the quantity levels of water in the Drava's old channel-lower part- nicely. The total surface of the district is around 26ha.

description: To je stara struga reke Drave, po kateri teče cca 15 m3 vode na sekundo. Po treh kilometrih se vanjo izliva še reka Dravinja, katere pretok vode se zelo spreminja - v sušnem obdobju komaj še teče, drugače pa precej dopolni količino vode v stari strugi reke Drave-spodnji del. Površina revirja je cca 26 ha. Dolžina revirja je cca 10 km. Je pretežno plitva struga, saj je globina vode redkokje večja od 1,5 m.

name: Reka Drava
subtitle: od Šmartinskega broda do sotočja z odvodnim kanalom SD 1, zgornja stara Drava

en.name: The river Drava
en.subtitle: from the cable ferry to the confluence with the drain SD 1, upper old Drava
en.description: This district runs along the old channel of the river Drava - where the Drava used to run before the hydropower plant SD 1 was built. When it was built only enough water ran through the dam in Melje to sustain the environmental flow but now it increased a little.

description: Ta revir poteka po stari strugi reke Drave, po kateri je reka Drava tekla pred izgradnjo hidroelektrarne SD1. Z izgradnjo te, je preko jezu v Melju teklo le toliko vode, da je bil dosežen biološki minimum, kar je sedaj nekoliko povečano. Večji del struge je plitek, saj je globina vode do 1 m, z zjemo večjih globin, ki so ostale še od takrat, ko je reka Drava tekla neukročena po naravni rečni strugi.

name: Ptujsko jezero
subtitle: reka Drava od sotočja stare struge in kanala SD1 do jezu v Markovcih

en.name: The lake Ptujsko jezero
en.subtitle: the river Drava from the confluence of the old channel and the drain of the SD 1 to the dam in Markovci
en.description: The lake was made when the hydropower plant SD 2 was built. The total surface of the district is 420ha. Boating and bird watching are always a possibility here -. due to largness of the lake the number of birds is high and constant throughout the year.The lake is pretty muddy in some parts-except in the middle where the Drava's channel runs through it.

description: Nastalo je ob gradnji HE SD2. Površina revirja je 420 ha. Na jezeru je možno čolnarjenje ter opazovanje ptic, katerih je zaradi velikosti jezera prisotno veliko število preko celega leta. Jezero je razen v osrednjem delu, kjer poteka struga reke Drave, na nekaterih delih precej zamuljeno. V jezeru prevladujejo krapi in ploščiči, v zadnjem času pa je vedno bolj prisotna ogrica.

name: Reka Dravinja
subtitle: od mostu v Doleni do Izliva v Dravo

en.name: The river Dravinja
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Dolena to the outflow into the Drava
en.description: The river Dravinja is a smaller river which rises very high when the rains are hard, floods the surroundings and also makes the fishing then impossible.But when its watercourse is normal there are many small places to be discovered - where you can fish and admire the beauty of the nature in Haloze simultaneously.

description: Reka Dravinja je manjša reka, ki ob deževjih močno naraste in poplavi okolico. Takrat je ribolov nemogoč. Pri normalnem vodostaju pa je ob Dravinji polno kotičkov, kjer si lahko privoščite ribolov ob opazovanju lepe narave na obrobju Haloz. Ob reki Dravinji so privatna kmetijska zemljišča, zato vas bo zmotil ob opazovanju narave kakšen traktor, drugače pa boste lahko uživali ob ribolovu.

name: Gramoznica Tržec

en.name: The gravel pit Tržec
en.description: The fishing district Gramoznica Tržec is situated in the gravel pit between the villages Videm, Tržec and Lancova vas.The total water surface of this district is approximately 8,5ha. The gravel pit Tržec is a district that is particularly meant for the fishing of first class fish specimens in catch&release style.

description: Ribolovni revir Gramoznica Tržec se nahaja v gramozni jami med vasmi Videm, Tržec in Lancova vas. Vodna površina tega revirja je cca 8.5 ha. Gramoznica Tržec je revir, ki je namenjen predvsem za izvajanje ribolova na kapitalno ribo na način ujemi & izpusti. Vsako leto vanj vložimo nekaj manjših krapov, ploščičev in ribjega drobiža ter neprestanoma stremimo k vlaganju kapitalnih rib. Gramoznica Tržec je t.i.

name: Pesnica

en.name: The river Pesnica
en.description: At the first sight the river Pesnica looks like a smaller creek but when the heavy autumn rains fall it rises high and threatens to flood the protection embankments that were made when the river was regulated.

description: Reka Pesnica je navidezno manjši potok, ki pa ob obilnem jesenskem deževju močno naraste in preti z razlitjem preko varovalnih nasipov, ki so bili zgrajeni ob regulaciji. Ravno takšne vode pa so skopale v regulirano rečno strugo polno jam, v katerih se skrivajo tudi kapitalni primerki somov in krapov.

name: Potok Polskava
subtitle: od mostu v Medvedcih do izliva v Dravinjo

en.name: The creek Polskava
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Medvedci to the outflow into the Dravinja
en.description: This watercourse is small and is home to many cyprinid fish species-especially smaller ones. It almost dries out in summertime especially when the drought hits. The total surface of this district measures approximately 3,6ha. According to the size the creek Polskava is the smallest fishing district among the open waters managed by the RD Ptuj.

description: Manjši vodotok, v katerem živi več vrst ciprinidnih vrst rib-predvsem manjših. V poletnih mesecih skoraj presahne, posebej še v sušnih obdobjih. Vodna površina tega revirja je cca 3,6 ha. Potok Polskava je po velikosti najmanjši ribolovni revir med odprtimi vodami, s katerim upravlja RD Ptuj.

name: Ribnik Rogoznica 1

en.name: The pond Rogoznica 1
en.description: The pond is actually an abandoned clay excavating site which was redesigned into the pond for recreational fishing. The total surface of the pond is 2,4ha. The pond is home to carps, grass carps, crucian and silver carps, common breams and other still water fish ( Danube roaches, common rudds, chubs, pikes, zanders, catfish).It is situated near the city of Ptuj on the road from Ptuj to Radenci.

description: Ribnik je v osnovi opuščen glinokop, ki je bil preurejen v ribnik za športni ribolov. Vodna površina ribnika je 2.4 ha. Ribnik je naseljen s krapi, amurji, srebrnimi koreslji in tolstolobiki, ploščiči in ostalimi ribami mirnih voda (rdečeoka, rdečeperka, klen, ščuka, smuč, som). Ribnik se nahaja v neposredni bližini mesta Ptuja ob cesti iz Ptuja proti Radencem.

name: Ribnik Rogoznica 2

en.name: The pond Rogoznica 2
en.description: The pond Rogoznica 2 was made from an abandoned clay excavating site and the only inflow of water it has are the meteoric waters. Due to newly arranged banks , since 2013 the access is also possible for the fishermen in wheelchairs-almost directly to the water. The pond is ideal for fishermen who love fishing itself and fish in catch&release style-the quantity of fish in the pond is high and so will their catch be.

description: Ribnik Rogoznica 2 je narejen iz opuščenega glinokopa. Kot takšen nima stalnega napajanja z vodo, saj so edini pritok meteorne vode. Zaradi novo urejenih nabrežin v letu 2013 je dostop omogočen tudi ribičem z invalidskimi vozički, saj se se lahko pripeljejo čisto do vode.

name: Odtočni kanal HE Zlatoličje - SD1

en.name: The drain of the hydropower plant Zlatoličje-SD1
en.description: This district's waters are relatively fast and are appropriate mostly for the ground fishing. The waters runs slow and the watercourse is low especially on Sunday mornings. The total surface of this district is 33ha. The bottom and the banks of this canal are pebbled. There are lots of shells on the bottom where your fishing line might entangle.

description: Razmeroma hitro tekoča voda, primerna predvsem za talni ribolov. Posebej še ob nedeljah je zjutraj vodostaj nizek, voda pa počasi tekoča. Površina tega revirja je cca 33 ha. Dno in nabrežine kanala so prodnati. Na dnu je precej školjk, v katere so pogosto zaplete vrvica.
